about: Floors of the building views quality gate (M005 S03). test-bk-views draws the side of each variant again with bk-views holdout and scores its pictures with bk-views style; a picture or a damage state's mean outside these fails. They come from the hold-out of these 23 variants (docs/superpowers/evidence/building-views/holdout.md): per picture 0.05 IoU under the worst, colour 10 and hue 0.1 over the worst, sharpness 0.1 under and 0.25 over the extremes of the hold-out and the style pictures; per state the mean IoU 0.02 and the mean SSIM 0.04 under the measured. Winter states count as their summer state. by_eye (M005 S06) lists variants whose turns pass the measures but look wrong on bk-views contact's sheet, with the reason; bk-views report lists them for hand fixing.
